messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must Member States provide for the first time the data and information referred to in Article 6(5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Entro quale data gli Stati membri devono fornire per la prima volta i dati e le informazioni di cui all'articolo 6, paragrafo 5, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
